This offer also applies to games purchased either through this auction or [url=http://www.boardgamegeek.com/geekmarket/user/greengow][COLOR=#009933][b]my marketplace[/b][/COLOR][/url] or combination of both.[/size][/COLOR]

:C: - Buyer pays for shipping costs. The costs will be disclosed once the location of the buyer is known, but you may inquire ahead of time per geekmail. Payments can occur either by sending a personal check (with 3 day’s holding time on my side), by sending a money order or by PayPal.
:E: - All final sales will be handled through the BGG Marketplace.
:F: - [size=18]Final Important Note: [/size]when you bid, please put your [b]ZIP CODE [/b]next to the bid such as
$$$ - [Zip Code]
[b][COLOR=#FF0000]This will speed up the process of me sending you the shipping costs once the auction is closed[/COLOR][/b]. That way I can ship everything quickly after receiving the payment and games will reach the winners as soon as I ship them.
